name: ResizeTable
label: Resize Table (HTTP)
description: Resizes an existing Excel table to a new range.

fields.name: TenantId
fields.label: Tenant ID
fields.description: The Azure AD tenant identifier (e.g., 'contoso.onmicrosoft.com' or a GUID). Used to authenticate with Microsoft 365.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Application (Client) ID of the Azure AD app registered to access Microsoft Graph.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The client secret of the Azure AD application. Ensure it has the necessary permissions (e.g., Files.ReadWrite.All).

fields.name: DriveId
fields.label: Drive ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the OneDrive or SharePoint document library drive where the workbook is stored.

fields.name: ItemId
fields.label: Workbook Item ID
fields.description: The Microsoft Graph DriveItem ID of the Excel workbook file.

fields.name: TableName
fields.label: Table Name
fields.description: The name of the existing Excel table to resize (e.g., 'Table1', 'SalesData').

fields.name: NewRange
fields.label: New Range Address
fields.description: The new A1-style range address for the table (e.g., 'A1:D20'). Must include headers and all data rows.
